reason: The cited evidence does not address any of the key premises. E1 discusses phase changes and oxidation in thermal-sprayed HEAs but does not link particle size to deposition efficiency or oxidation reduction. E2 describes a laser deposition process with a different intervention (toolpath) and material system, providing no support for the agglomeration mechanism or its effects on thickness and oxidation.
